# ExUnitBuildkite v0.2.0 - Table of Contents

Real-time Buildkite annotations for ExUnit test failures

## Pages

- [ExUnitBuildkite](https://exunit-buildkite.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [ExUnitBuildkite](https://exunit-buildkite.hexdocs.pm/ExUnitBuildkite.md): Real-time Buildkite build annotations for ExUnit test failures.
- [ExUnitBuildkite.Formatter](https://exunit-buildkite.hexdocs.pm/ExUnitBuildkite.Formatter.md): An ExUnit formatter that annotates Buildkite builds with test failures in real-time.
